#PART A.Phenotype Data and trentd analysis

#plot for FQ-R Salmonella Enteritidis in Chicken and Human Sources 

# remove 2025 and also 95% C.I
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

data <- read_csv(
  "FDASEN_AMRPhenotype2.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

trend <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),

    Source = factor(
      as.character(Source),
      levels = c("Human", "Chicken")
    ),

    Cip_Resistant = as.numeric(Cip_Resistant),
    Cip_Tested    = as.numeric(Cip_Tested),

    DSC_Resistant = as.numeric(DSC_Resistant),
    DSC_Tested    = as.numeric(DSC_Tested)
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(Year),
    !Year %in% c(2024, 2025)
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Tested = pmax(
      Cip_Tested,
      DSC_Tested,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    # =====================================================
    # PHENOTYPE PERCENTAGES
    # =====================================================

    CipR_pct = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * Cip_Resistant / Tested,
      NA_real_
    ),

    DSC_pct = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * DSC_Resistant / Tested,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # Internal name = QRFQR
    # Displayed name later = QR/FQR
    QRFQR_pct = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * (Cip_Resistant + DSC_Resistant) / Tested,
      NA_real_
    ),


    # =====================================================
    # 95% CI — NORMAL APPROXIMATION
    # =====================================================

    CipR_se = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * sqrt(
        (Cip_Resistant / Tested) *
          (1 - (Cip_Resistant / Tested)) /
          Tested
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),

    DSC_se = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * sqrt(
        (DSC_Resistant / Tested) *
          (1 - (DSC_Resistant / Tested)) /
          Tested
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),

    QRFQR_se = if_else(
      Tested > 0,
      100 * sqrt(
        (
          ((Cip_Resistant + DSC_Resistant) / Tested) *
            (1 - ((Cip_Resistant + DSC_Resistant) / Tested)) /
            Tested
        )
      ),
      NA_real_
    ),


    # =====================================================
    # CONFIDENCE LIMITS
    # =====================================================

    CipR_lo = CipR_pct - 1.96 * CipR_se,
    CipR_hi = CipR_pct + 1.96 * CipR_se,

    DSC_lo = DSC_pct - 1.96 * DSC_se,
    DSC_hi = DSC_pct + 1.96 * DSC_se,

    QRFQR_lo = QRFQR_pct - 1.96 * QRFQR_se,
    QRFQR_hi = QRFQR_pct + 1.96 * QRFQR_se
  ) %>%

  select(
    Year,
    Source,

    QRFQR_pct,
    QRFQR_lo,
    QRFQR_hi,

    DSC_pct,
    DSC_lo,
    DSC_hi,

    CipR_pct,
    CipR_lo,
    CipR_hi
  ) %>%

  # =======================================================
  # LONG FORMAT
  #
  # QRFQR is used internally because "/" in variable names
  # would complicate parsing.
  # =======================================================

  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Year, Source),

    names_to = c(
      "Metric",
      ".value"
    ),

    names_pattern =
      "^(QRFQR|DSC|CipR)_(pct|lo|hi)$"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # =====================================================
    # DISPLAY LABELS
    # =====================================================

    Metric = recode(
      Metric,

      QRFQR = "Nal-R/DSC or Cip-R",

      DSC = "Nal-R/DSC",

      CipR = "Cip-R"
    ),

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "Nal-R/DSC or Cip-R",
        "Nal-R/DSC",
        "Cip-R"
      )
    ),

    lo = pmax(
      lo,
      0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    Metric
  ) %>%

  complete(
    Year = full_seq(Year, 1)
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


# =========================================================
# SHAPES
# =========================================================

shape_map <- c(
  "Nal-R/DSC or Cip-R" = 16,
  "Nal-R/DSC"                   = 15,
  "Cip-R"                       = 17
)


# =========================================================
# PLOT
# =========================================================

p <- ggplot(
  trend,
  aes(
    x = Year,
    y = pct,
    color = Source,
    linetype = Metric
  )
) +

  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lo,
      ymax = hi,
      fill = Source
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = Metric
    ),
    size = 2.0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(
    values = shape_map
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Human" = "red",
      "Chicken" = "blue"
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Human" = "red",
      "Chicken" = "blue"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(12)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),

    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0.05
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year of Isolation",
    y = "Percentage (%)",

    color = "Source",
    fill = "Source",

    linetype = "Phenotype",
    shape = "Phenotype"

    # title = "Quinolone/fluoroquinolone resistance trends (Human vs Chicken) with 95% CI"
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25
    ),

    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.25
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# PRINT
# =========================================================

print(p)


# =========================================================
# SAVE
# =========================================================

ggsave(
  "FQ_trends_Human_vs_Chicken.png",
  p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 1200
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_trends_Human_vs_Chicken.pdf",
  p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8
)

ggsave(
  "FQ_trends_Human_vs_Chicken.tif",
  p,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8
)

```


#PArtB. Genotpe data and trend analysis and genome selection

#1. load the Datasets 
```{r}
# ================================
# READ FILE (choose ONE)
# ================================

# ---- A) If it's REALLY a CSV ----
file_path <- "US-SEN_12192025.csv"
SEN <- read_csv(file_path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
```

#2. Filter all quinolone/fluoroquinole-resistance marker 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"

# Broad QR marker regex (genes + QRDR mutations + PMQR + efflux/regulators)
pattern_fqr_all <- paste0(
  "(^|,)(",
  # QRDR mutations
  "gyr[a-b]_[^,=]+|par[c-e]_[^,=]+|",
  # PMQR genes
  "qnr[a-z0-9._-]*|aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr|qep[a-z0-9._-]*|oqx[a-b]|",
  # additional PMQR / emerging markers
  "qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*|crpP|",
  # efflux & regulators often annotated as POINT
  "acr[a-b]_[^,=]+|tolc_[^,=]+|ram[ar]_[^,=]+|mar[ar]_[^,=]+|sox[rs]_[^,=]+",
  ")(?==)"
)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    amr_txt = str_to_lower(as.character(.data[[amr_col]])),
    amr_txt = if_else(is.na(amr_txt), "", amr_txt),
    FQR_genotype = if_else(
      str_detect(amr_txt, regex(pattern_fqr_all, ignore_case = TRUE)),
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-amr_txt)


SEN %>%
  count(FQR_genotype)



```
#3. Frequency of all (Top100) FQR markers 
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# =========================
# CONFIG
# =========================
amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"
id_col  <- "Isolate"   # CHANGE if needed

# =========================
# Pretty display casing for FQR markers (comprehensive for your list)
# - gene family corrected (gyrA, qnrB, etc.)
# - mutation part uppercased (e.g., gyrA_d87g -> gyrA_D87G)
# - keeps underscore format: gyrA_D87G, qnrB19, qnrVC1
# =========================
pretty_token <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")

  # replace only at start, keep remainder (e.g., qnrb19 -> qnrB19; gyra_d87g -> gyrA_d87g)
  fix_start <- function(s, from, to) {
    str_replace(s, paste0("^", from), to)
  }

  # chromosomal targets
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyra", "gyrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyrb", "gyrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "parc", "parC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pare", "parE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pard", "parD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "grla", "grlA")

  # PMQR: qnr family
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnras", "qnrAS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnra",  "qnrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrb",  "qnrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrc",  "qnrC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrd",  "qnrD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnre",  "qnrE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrs",  "qnrS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrvc", "qnrVC")

  # qepA (and qep variants)
  x <- fix_start(x, "qepa", "qepA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qep",  "qep")

  # other families you listed / QR-linked
  x <- fix_start(x, "nfxb", "nfxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "emrr", "emrR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "norm", "norM")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pmra", "pmrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "acrb", "acrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "smef", "smeF")

  # prior extras
  x <- fix_start(x, "acra", "acrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "tolc", "tolC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "crpp", "crpP")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxa", "oqxA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxb", "oqxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "rama", "ramA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "ramr", "ramR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "mara", "marA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "marr", "marR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxr", "soxR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxs", "soxS")

  # exact enzyme token (keep exact casing)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "^aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr", "aac(6')-Ib-cr")

  # uppercase mutation / suffix after first underscore if present: gyrA_d87g -> gyrA_D87G
  parts <- str_split_fixed(x, "_", 2)
  gene_part <- parts[, 1]
  rest_part <- parts[, 2]
  rest_part <- ifelse(rest_part == "", rest_part, toupper(rest_part))
  x <- ifelse(rest_part == "", gene_part, paste0(gene_part, "_", rest_part))

  x
}

# =========================
# FQR marker regex (includes your 20 gene families + prior QR markers)
# =========================
fqr_regex <- regex(
  paste0(
    "^(",
    "(gyr[a-b](?:_.+)?|par[c-e](?:_.+)?|grla(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(qnr(as|[a-z0-9._-]*))(?:$)|",
    "(qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(qep[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(nfxb(?:_.+)?|emrr(?:_.+)?|norm(?:_.+)?|pmra(?:_.+)?|acrb(?:_.+)?|smef(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr(?:_.+)?|oqx[a-b](?:_.+)?|crpp(?:_.+)?|acr[a-b](?:_.+)?|tolc(?:_.+)?|ram[ar](?:_.+)?|mar[ar](?:_.+)?|sox[rs](?:_.+)?)(?:$)",
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

# =========================
# 1) Tokenize AMR genotypes
# =========================
SEN_tok <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),
    amr_txt = as.character(.data[[amr_col]]),
    amr_txt = if_else(is.na(amr_txt), "", amr_txt),
    token = str_extract_all(amr_txt, "[^,=\\s]+(?==)")
  ) %>%
  select(isolate_id, token) %>%
  unnest_longer(token) %>%
  mutate(
    token = str_trim(token),
    token = str_replace_all(token, "\\s+", "")
  )

# =========================
# 2) Keep only FQR-related markers
# =========================
SEN_fqr_tokens <- SEN_tok %>%
  filter(str_detect(token, fqr_regex)) %>%
  mutate(
    token_norm   = str_to_lower(token),
    token_pretty = pretty_token(token_norm)
  )

# =========================
# 3) TABLE: frequency, percent, 95% CI per marker + susceptible
#    Denominator = number of UNIQUE isolates in SEN
# =========================
all_isolates <- SEN %>%
  transmute(isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]])) %>%
  distinct()

N_isolates <- nrow(all_isolates)

isolates_any_marker <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id)

n_any  <- nrow(isolates_any_marker)
n_susc <- N_isolates - n_any

marker_table <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id, token_pretty) %>%
  count(token_pretty, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  mutate(
    Type = "QR/FQR marker",
    N = N_isolates,
    p = n_isolates / N,
    pct = 100 * p,
    se = sqrt(p * (1 - p) / N),
    lo = pmax(0, 100 * (p - 1.96 * se)),
    hi = pmin(100, 100 * (p + 1.96 * se))
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      token_pretty = "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      n_isolates = n_susc,
      Type = "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      N = N_isolates,
      p = n_susc / N_isolates,
      pct = 100 * (n_susc / N_isolates),
      se = sqrt((n_susc / N_isolates) * (1 - (n_susc / N_isolates)) / N_isolates),
      lo = pmax(0, 100 * ((n_susc / N_isolates) - 1.96 * sqrt((n_susc / N_isolates) * (1 - (n_susc / N_isolates)) / N_isolates))),
      hi = pmin(100, 100 * ((n_susc / N_isolates) + 1.96 * sqrt((n_susc / N_isolates) * (1 - (n_susc / N_isolates)) / N_isolates)))
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates))

print(marker_table, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  marker_table %>% select(token_pretty, Type, n_isolates, N, pct, lo, hi),
  "FQR_marker_frequency_percentage_95CI_with_susceptible.csv"
)

# =========================
# 4) Plot: top 100 markers with count + (percent) labels
#    - percent shown to 3 decimal places
#    - if percent < 0.01% show "<0.01%"
#    Susceptible bar is BLUE; all other bars are PINK3 (as you had)
# =========================
plot_df <- marker_table %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  mutate(
    token_pretty = factor(token_pretty, levels = rev(token_pretty)),
    pct_label_plot = if_else(pct < 0.01, "<0.01%", sprintf("%.3f%%", pct)),
    label_plot = paste0(n_isolates, " (", pct_label_plot, ")")
  )

p_tokens <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = token_pretty, y = n_isolates, fill = Type)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_plot), hjust = -0.1, size =3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Q/FQ-susceptible" = "green4", "QR/FQR marker" = "red3")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 22000),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(x = "QR/FQR Markers", y = "Number of Genomes(n (%))") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_tokens)

ggsave("FQR_marker_counts_top100.png", p_tokens, width = 7.5, height = 10, dpi = 600)
ggsave("FQR_marker_counts_top100.tif", p_tokens, width = 7.5, height = 10, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
ggsave("FQR_marker_counts_top100.pdf", p_tokens, width = 7.5, height = 10)

# =========================
# 5) Per-isolate marker counts + print counts/percentages
# =========================
iso_marker_list <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id, token_norm, token_pretty) %>%
  group_by(isolate_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_markers = n(),
    markers = paste(sort(unique(token_pretty)), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

marker_bins <- iso_marker_list %>%
  mutate(bin = case_when(
    n_markers == 1 ~ "1 marker",
    n_markers == 2 ~ "2 markers",
    n_markers >  2 ~ ">2 markers",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bin)) %>%
  count(bin, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_isolates = 100 * n_isolates / sum(n_isolates),
    bin = factor(bin, levels = c("1 marker", "2 markers", ">2 markers"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(bin)

print(marker_bins, n = Inf)

cat("\nMarker burden summary (FQR markers only):\n")
marker_bins %>%
  mutate(line = sprintf("%s: %d isolates (%.1f%%)", bin, n_isolates, pct_isolates)) %>%
  pull(line) %>%
  cat(sep = "\n")
cat("\n")

# =========================
# 6) Table + CSV of isolates with >1 marker (and their markers)
# =========================
iso_gt1 <- iso_marker_list %>%
  filter(n_markers > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_markers), isolate_id)

print(iso_gt1, n = Inf)
write_csv(iso_gt1, "isolates_more_than_one_FQR_marker.csv")

# =========================
# 7) Plot: marker-burden bins + save
#    STRICTLY red3
# =========================
p_bins <- ggplot(marker_bins, aes(x = bin, y = n_isolates)) +
  geom_col(fill = "red3") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%d (%.2f%%)", n_isolates, pct_isolates)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of QR/FQR markers per isolate",
    y = "Number of isolates"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_bins)

ggsave(
  "FQR_marker_burden_bins.png",
  p_bins,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.2,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "FQR_marker_burden_bins.tif",
  p_bins,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.2,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw"
)

ggsave(
  "FQR_marker_burden_bins.pdf",
  p_bins,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 4.2
)


# ============================================================
# 8) EXACTLY 2 QR/FQR MARKERS:
#    Unique marker-combination counts
# ============================================================

combo_2 <- iso_marker_list %>%
  filter(n_markers == 2) %>%
  count(markers, name = "n_isolates") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n_isolates / sum(n_isolates),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.2f%%", pct),
    label_plot = paste0(n_isolates, " (", pct_label, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_isolates), markers)

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("Unique combinations of exactly 2 QR/FQR markers\n")
cat("============================================\n")

print(combo_2, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  combo_2,
  "FQR_exactly_2_marker_combinations.csv"
)


# Order combinations by frequency
combo_2_plot <- combo_2 %>%
  mutate(
    markers = factor(
      markers,
      levels = rev(markers)
    )
  )


# Dynamic plot height so labels remain readable
height_2 <- max(
  5,
  0.28 * nrow(combo_2_plot) + 1.5
)


p_combo_2 <- ggplot(
  combo_2_plot,
  aes(x = markers, y = n_isolates)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "red3") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label_plot),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Unique combination of 2 QR/FQR markers",
    y = "Number of isolates"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
```

#4. Downsize the QR-markers to focus on most important
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"

# =========================
# 1) TOKENIZE + keep ALL QR tokens (original chart data)
# =========================
SEN_tok <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    amr_txt = as.character(.data[[amr_col]]),
    amr_txt = if_else(is.na(amr_txt), "", amr_txt),
    token = str_extract_all(amr_txt, "[^,=\\s]+(?==)")
  ) %>%
  select(token) %>%
  unnest_longer(token) %>%
  mutate(
    token = str_trim(token),
    token = str_replace_all(token, "\\s+", "")
  )

SEN_qr_tokens <- SEN_tok %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      token,
      regex(
        "^(gyr[a-b]_.+|par[c-e]_.+|qnr[a-z0-9._-]*|qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*|aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr|qep[a-z0-9._-]*|oqx[a-b]|crpP|acr[a-b]_.+|tolc_.+|ram[ar]_.+|mar[ar]_.+|sox[rs]_.+)$",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(token_norm = str_to_lower(token))

# =========================
# 2) ORIGINAL CHART (top 100 unique tokens)
# =========================
qr_token_counts <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  count(token_norm, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  mutate(token_norm = factor(token_norm, levels = rev(token_norm)))

p_original <- ggplot(qr_token_counts, aes(x = token_norm, y = n, fill = token_norm)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Unique QR marker", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_original)

# =========================
# 3) NEW CHART:
#    keep top 5 gyrA tokens as-is, group the rest into families:
#    gyrA_others, qnr_all, gyrB_all, parC_all, parD_all, parE_all, etc.
# =========================

# top 5 gyrA tokens (by count)
top5_gyrA <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  filter(str_detect(token_norm, "^gyra_")) %>%
  count(token_norm, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(token_norm)

# relabel into grouped buckets
SEN_qr_grouped <- SEN_qr_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    marker_group = case_when(
      token_norm %in% top5_gyrA ~ token_norm,

      str_detect(token_norm, "^gyra_") ~ "gyra_others",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^gyrb_") ~ "gyrb_all",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^parc_") ~ "parc_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^pard_") ~ "pard_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^pare_") ~ "pare_all",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^qnrvc") ~ "qnrvc_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^qnr")   ~ "qnr_all",

      token_norm == "aac(6')-ib-cr"    ~ "aac(6')-ib-cr",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^qep")   ~ "qep_all",
      token_norm == "oqxa"             ~ "oqxa",
      token_norm == "oqxb"             ~ "oqxb",
      token_norm == "crpp"             ~ "crpp",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^acra_") ~ "acra_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^acrb_") ~ "acrb_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^tolc_") ~ "tolc_all",

      str_detect(token_norm, "^rama_") ~ "rama_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^ramr_") ~ "ramr_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^mara_") ~ "mara_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^marr_") ~ "marr_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^soxr_") ~ "soxr_all",
      str_detect(token_norm, "^soxs_") ~ "soxs_all",

      TRUE ~ "other_qr"
    )
  )

qr_group_counts <- SEN_qr_grouped %>%
  count(marker_group, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(marker_group = factor(marker_group, levels = rev(marker_group)))

p_grouped <- ggplot(qr_group_counts, aes(x = marker_group, y = n, fill = marker_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 15000), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "QR marker (top 5 gyrA kept, others grouped)", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_grouped)



```
#5. A. Yearly distribute of all SEN sequenced isolates B. Yearly distribution stacked into QR and non-QR
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ============================================================
# 1) ROBUSTLY EXTRACT COLLECTION YEAR
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Collection_date_raw = as.character(`Collection date`),

    Collection_date_clean = Collection_date_raw %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_replace_all("_", "-") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\.", "/") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all(
        "(?i)^(na|n/a|none|unknown|unk|\\.)$",
        NA_character_
      ),

    Collection_date_parsed = suppressWarnings(
      parse_date_time(
        Collection_date_clean,
        orders = c(
          "Ymd", "Y-m-d", "Y/m/d",
          "mdY", "m/d/Y", "m-d-Y", "m.d.Y",
          "dmY", "d/m/Y", "d-m-Y", "d.m.Y",
          "b d Y", "d b Y", "B d Y", "d B Y",
          "Y b d", "Y B d",
          "b Y", "B Y",
          "Y b", "Y B",
          "Y"
        ),
        tz = "UTC",
        exact = FALSE
      )
    ),

    Collection_year = year(Collection_date_parsed),

    # Fallback to any plausible four-digit year
    Collection_year = if_else(
      is.na(Collection_year),
      suppressWarnings(
        as.integer(
          str_extract(
            Collection_date_clean,
            "(19|20)\\d{2}"
          )
        )
      ),
      Collection_year
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 2) QUICK CHECK OF COLLECTION YEARS
# ============================================================

SEN %>%
  count(Collection_year, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# ============================================================
# 3) DERIVE QR/FQR STATUS FROM YOUR EXISTING MARKER TABLE
# ============================================================
# SEN_fqr_tokens was created in your previous QR/FQR marker
# extraction workflow.
#
# ≥1 detected QR/FQR marker = "QR/FQR marker"
# no detected QR/FQR marker = "Q/FQ-susceptible"
# ============================================================

qr_isolates <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id) %>%
  mutate(QR_group = "QR/FQR marker")


SEN_year <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]])
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    qr_isolates,
    by = "isolate_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    QR_group = if_else(
      is.na(QR_group),
      "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      QR_group
    ),

    QR_group = factor(
      QR_group,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# Check classification
SEN_year %>%
  count(QR_group) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# ============================================================
# 4) FIGURE 1:
#    NUMBER OF GENOMES BY COLLECTION YEAR
# ============================================================

yr_counts <- SEN_year %>%
  filter(!is.na(Collection_year)) %>%
  count(Collection_year, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    Collection_year = seq(
      min(Collection_year),
      max(Collection_year)
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Collection_year)


p_years <- ggplot(
  yr_counts,
  aes(
    x = factor(Collection_year),
    y = n
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Collection year",
    y = "Number of genomes"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_years)


# ============================================================
# 5) FIGURE 2:
#    STACKED Q/FQ-SUSCEPTIBLE vs QR/FQR MARKER BY YEAR
# ============================================================

yr_qr <- SEN_year %>%
  filter(!is.na(Collection_year)) %>%
  count(
    Collection_year,
    QR_group,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    Collection_year = seq(
      min(Collection_year),
      max(Collection_year)
    ),
    QR_group = factor(
      c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Collection_year,
    QR_group
  )


p_year_qr <- ggplot(
  yr_qr,
  aes(
    x = factor(Collection_year),
    y = n,
    fill = QR_group
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Q/FQ-susceptible" = "green4",
      "QR/FQR marker" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Collection year",
    y = "Number of genomes",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

print(p_year_qr)


# ============================================================
# 6) SAVE FIGURES
# ============================================================

ggsave(
  "SEN_collection_year_counts.png",
  p_years,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "SEN_collection_year_counts.pdf",
  p_years,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.5
)


ggsave(
  "SEN_QRFQR_by_collection_year.png",
  p_year_qr,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 600
)

ggsave(
  "SEN_QRFQR_by_collection_year.tif",
  p_year_qr,
  width = 9,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 600,

)

ggsave(
  "SEN_QRFQR_by_collection_year.pdf",

)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

      QR_group,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# HELPER: MAKE PLOTS FOR A GIVEN YEAR WINDOW
# ============================================================

make_year_plots <- function(
    df,
    year_min = NULL,
    year_max = NULL,
    tag = "ALL"
) {

  d <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Collection_year))

  # Apply selected year range
  if (!is.null(year_min)) {
    d <- d %>%
      filter(Collection_year >= year_min)
  }

  if (!is.null(year_max)) {
    d <- d %>%
      filter(Collection_year <= year_max)
  }

  # Safety check
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    warning(
      paste0(
        "No genomes found for year window: ",
        tag
      )
    )
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # 1) TOTAL GENOMES PER YEAR
  # ==========================================================

  yr_counts <- d %>%
    count(
      Collection_year,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      Collection_year = seq(
        min(Collection_year),
        max(Collection_year)
      ),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Collection_year)


  p_years <- ggplot(
    yr_counts,
    aes(
      x = factor(Collection_year),
      y = n
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      fill = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(n == 0, "", n)
      ),
      vjust = -0.3,
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0, 0.08)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Collection year",
      y = "Number of genomes",
      title = paste0(
        "Genome counts by collection year (",
        tag,
        ")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        vjust = 0.5,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 5
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 7
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p_years)


  # ==========================================================
  # 2) Q/FQ-SUSCEPTIBLE vs QR/FQR MARKER PER YEAR
  # ==========================================================

  yr_qr <- d %>%
    count(
      Collection_year,
      QR_group,
      name = "n"
    ) %>%
    complete(
      Collection_year = seq(
        min(Collection_year),
        max(Collection_year)
      ),
      QR_group = factor(
        c(
          "Q/FQ-susceptible",
          "QR/FQR marker"
        ),
        levels = c(
          "Q/FQ-susceptible",
          "QR/FQR marker"
        )
      ),
      fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      Collection_year,
      QR_group
    )


  p_year_qr <- ggplot(
    yr_qr,
    aes(
      x = factor(Collection_year),
      y = n,
      fill = QR_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(
          n == 0,
          "",
          n
        )
      ),
      position = position_stack(
        vjust = 0.5
      ),
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible" = "green4",
        "QR/FQR marker" = "red3"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Collection year",
      y = "Number of genomes",
      fill = "",
      title = paste0(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible vs QR/FQR marker by year (",
        tag,
        ")"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 90,
        vjust = 0.5,
        hjust = 1,
        size = 5
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 7
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 8,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 9,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 8
      )
    )

  print(p_year_qr)


  # ==========================================================
  # RETURN PLOTS + DATA
  # ==========================================================

  invisible(
    list(
      counts_data = yr_counts,
      qr_data = yr_qr,
      counts_plot = p_years,
      qr_plot = p_year_qr
    )
  )
}
```

#7. looking deeply into Sources type
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# ---- standardize columns ----
SEN3 <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source_type = str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(`Source type`))),
    Source_type = if_else(is.na(Source_type) | Source_type == "", "unknown", Source_type),
    Isolation_source = str_trim(as.character(`Isolation source`)),
    Isolation_source = if_else(is.na(Isolation_source) | Isolation_source == "", "Unknown", Isolation_source)
  )

# ---- function: bar plot of Isolation source counts for one Source type ----
plot_iso_counts <- function(df, stype, top_n = 50) {
  dat <- df %>%
    filter(Source_type == stype) %>%
    count(Isolation_source, sort = TRUE, name = "n") %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    mutate(Isolation_source = factor(Isolation_source, levels = rev(Isolation_source)))

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = Isolation_source, y = n, fill = Isolation_source)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.2) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      x = "Isolation source",
      y = "Count",
      title = paste0("Isolation source counts (", stype, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title  = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title  = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ---- plots for requested source types ----
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "animal"))
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "environmental"))
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "food"))
print(plot_iso_counts(SEN3, "unknown"))
```

#8. Reclassifying sources into Human, chicken and others

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    st  = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Source type`))),
    iso = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Isolation source`))),
    iso = if_else(is.na(iso), "", iso),

    # normalize: letters only + fix misspellings + split glued "chickenwings" etc.
    iso_norm = iso %>%
      str_replace_all("[^a-z]+", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all("chicken(?=[a-z])", "chicken ") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bchicekn\\b", "chicken") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bchikcen\\b", "chicken") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bchcken\\b", "chicken") %>%
      str_squish(),

    Source = case_when(
      str_detect(st, "\\bhuman\\b") ~ "Human",

      # Chicken + egg + hatchery terms
      str_detect(
        iso_norm,
        paste0(
          "\\bchicken\\b|\\bchick\\b|\\bpoultry\\b|\\bhen\\b|",
          "\\bbroiler\\b|\\blayer\\b|\\bgallus\\b|gallus\\s+gallus|",
          "\\begg\\b|\\beggs\\b|\\begg\\s*product\\b|\\bproduct\\s*eggs\\b|\\begg\\s*yolk(s)?\\b|\\byolk(s)?\\b|",
          "\\bhatchery\\b|\\bhatching\\b|\\bhatcher(y)?\\b|",
          "\\bbox\\s*liner(s)?\\b|\\bliner(s)?\\b|\\bdrag\\s*swab(s)?\\b"
        )
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-st, -iso, -iso_norm)

SEN %>% count(Source, sort = TRUE)


```
#manually inspect others and improve 

# I manually inspected the other data and reassigned some samples back: further refined the Source classification for isolates initially labeled as “Other.”First, if the Host or IFSAC category fields contained any mention of “chicken,” these isolates were reclassified to the Chicken source. Second, if the Collected by field contained “CDC,” the isolate was reclassified to the Human source. After applying these rules, we recalculated the final counts of isolates per source category (Human, Chicken, Other, International).
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Host_l   = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(Host))),
    Ifsac_l  = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`IFSAC category`))),
    Collect_l = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Collected by`))),

    Source = case_when(
      # Reclassify "Other" to Chicken if Host or IFSAC mention chicken
      Source == "Other" & (
        str_detect(Host_l, "chicken") |
        str_detect(Ifsac_l, "chicken")
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      # Reclassify "Other" to Human if Collected by CDC
      Source == "Other" & str_detect(Collect_l, "cdc") ~ "Human",

      TRUE ~ Source
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Host_l, -Ifsac_l, -Collect_l)

SEN %>% count(Source, sort = TRUE)



```

#10b. Inspect the other sources and re-classify sources into Turkey, cattel, Sheep/goat, Swin and Others

```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
# REFINE THE CURRENT "Other" SOURCE CATEGORY
#
# New categories:
#   Turkey
#   Cattle
#   Sheep/goat
#   Swine
#   Others
#
# Original Source column is preserved.
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    isolation_source_clean = `Isolation source` %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower(),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Classify ONLY records currently designated Source = Other
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    Other_source_group = case_when(

      # ======================================================
      # TURKEY
      # Includes live-animal, cecal, meat and turkey products
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          "\\bturkey\\b"
        ) ~ "Turkey",


      # ======================================================
      # CATTLE
      # Includes cattle, bovine, beef, steer, calf, Bos taurus
      # and beef products
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "cattle|",
            "bovine|",
            "beef|",
            "steer|",
            "calf|",
            "veal|",
            "bos taurus",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~ "Cattle",


      # ======================================================
      # SHEEP / GOAT
      # Includes sheep, lamb, ovine, goat and caprine
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "sheep|",
            "lamb|",
            "ovine|",
            "goat|",
            "caprine",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~ "Sheep/goat",


      # ======================================================
      # SWINE
      # Includes swine, sow, pork, porcine.
      #
      # Deliberately NOT using generic "pig" because
      # "guinea pig" occurs in your data and should remain Other.
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" &
        str_detect(
          isolation_source_clean,
          paste0(
            "\\b(",
            "swine|",
            "sow|",
            "pork|",
            "porcine",
            ")\\b"
          )
        ) ~ "Swine",


      # ======================================================
      # EVERYTHING ELSE CURRENTLY IN "Other"
      # ======================================================
      Source == "Other" ~ "Others",

      # Non-Other records left untouched here
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Other_source_group = factor(
      Other_source_group,
      levels = c(
        "Turkey",
        "Cattle",
        "Sheep/goat",
        "Swine",
        "Others"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# CHECK COUNTS
# ============================================================

other_group_counts <- SEN %>%
  filter(Source == "Other") %>%
  count(
    Other_source_group,
    name = "n",
    sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )

print(other_group_counts, n = Inf)


# ============================================================
# SAVE SUMMARY
# ============================================================

write_csv(
  other_group_counts,
  "SEN_Other_source_refined_groups.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# AUDIT TABLE:
# See exactly how every Isolation source was classified
# ============================================================

other_source_audit <- SEN %>%
  filter(Source == "Other") %>%
  mutate(
    isolation_source_display = str_squish(
      as.character(`Isolation source`)
    ),
    isolation_source_display = if_else(
      is.na(isolation_source_display) |
        isolation_source_display == "",
      "Unknown",
      isolation_source_display
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    Other_source_group,
    isolation_source_display,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Other_source_group,
    desc(n),
    isolation_source_display
  )

print(other_source_audit, n = Inf)

write_csv(
  other_source_audit,
  "SEN_Other_source_refined_audit.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# OPTIONAL:
# CREATE A FULL REFINED SOURCE VARIABLE
#
# Existing non-"Other" Source categories are retained.
# Only Source == "Other" is replaced by one of the five groups.
# ============================================================

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source_refined = if_else(
      Source == "Other",
      as.character(Other_source_group),
      as.character(Source)
    )
  )


# Check final source distribution
source_refined_counts <- SEN %>%
  count(
    Source_refined,
    name = "n",

  )

write_csv(
  source_refined_counts,
```

#11. reclassify FDA samples to seperate non-US sources isolated in the US
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

usa_pat <- "(\\busa\\b|\\bunited\\s*states\\b|\\bu\\s*\\.\\s*s\\s*\\.\\b|\\bus\\b)"
id_pat  <- "(\\bcfsan\\b|\\bfda\\b)"

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source = as.character(Source),

    Strain_l = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(Strain))),
    IsoID_l  = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Isolate identifiers`))),
    Strain_l = if_else(is.na(Strain_l), "", Strain_l),
    IsoID_l  = if_else(is.na(IsoID_l), "", IsoID_l),
    is_fda_like = str_detect(Strain_l, "^fda") | str_detect(IsoID_l, id_pat),

    Food_l = str_to_lower(str_squish(as.character(`Food origin`))),
    Food_l = if_else(is.na(Food_l), "", Food_l),

    # UPDATED: if FDA/CFSAN-linked but Food origin missing -> treat as US (no Unknown bucket)
    Origin_group = case_when(
      !is_fda_like ~ "US",
      Food_l == "" ~ "US",
      str_detect(Food_l, usa_pat) ~ "US",
      TRUE ~ "Non-US"
    ),

    Source_group = case_when(
      str_to_lower(Source) == "human" ~ "Human",
      str_to_lower(Source) == "chicken" ~ paste0("Chicken-", Origin_group),
      str_to_lower(Source) == "other"   ~ paste0("Other-", Origin_group),
      TRUE ~ paste0(Source, "-", Origin_group)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-Strain_l, -IsoID_l, -Food_l)

# Frequencies (no *-Unknown will exist now)
SEN %>%
  count(Source_group, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

SEN %>%
  count(Source, Origin_group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Origin_group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


SEN %>% count(Source, sort = TRUE)
```

#Decomposing Other-US sources and internation source to various source category
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

id_col <- "Isolate"

# ============================================================
# 1) QR/FQR STATUS
#    Uses the existing SEN_fqr_tokens object
# ============================================================

qr_isolates <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id) %>%
  mutate(
    QR_status = "QR/FQR marker"
  )


# ============================================================
# 2) EXTRACT THE TWO CERTIFIED GROUPS
#
# International-Non-US -> International
# Other-US-US           -> Other-US
#
# Then assign animal source
# ============================================================

source_animal_qr <- SEN %>%
  filter(
    Source_group %in% c(
      "International-Non-US",
      "Other-US-US"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),

    Group = recode(
      Source_group,
      "International-Non-US" = "International",
      "Other-US-US" = "Other-US"
    ),

    isolation_clean = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(`Isolation source`))
    ),

    Animal_source = case_when(

      # Chicken
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(chicken|broiler|hen)\\b"
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      # Turkey
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\bturkey\\b"
      ) ~ "Turkey",

      # Cattle
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(cattle|bovine|beef|steer|calf|veal|bos taurus)\\b"
      ) ~ "Cattle",

      # Sheep / goat
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(sheep|lamb|ovine|goat|caprine)\\b"
      ) ~ "Sheep/goat",

      # Swine
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(swine|sow|pork|porcine)\\b"
      ) ~ "Swine",

      # Everything else
      TRUE ~ "Others"
    )
  ) %>%

  # One row per isolate
  distinct(
    isolate_id,
    Group,
    Animal_source
  ) %>%

  # Join QR/FQR classification
  left_join(
    qr_isolates,
    by = "isolate_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    QR_status = if_else(
      is.na(QR_status),
      "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      QR_status
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3) CHECK TOTALS
# ============================================================

source_animal_qr %>%
  count(Group, name = "n") %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# Expected:
# International = 71
# Other-US      = 515


# ============================================================
# 4) COUNTS BY GROUP × ANIMAL SOURCE × QR STATUS
# ============================================================

animal_qr_counts <- source_animal_qr %>%
  count(
    Group,
    Animal_source,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Group,
    Animal_source
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_source = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / total_source,
    label = paste0(
      n,
      " (",
      sprintf("%.1f", pct),
      "%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


print(
  animal_qr_counts,
  n = Inf
)

write_csv(
  animal_qr_counts,
  "SEN_International_OtherUS_animal_QRFQR_counts.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 5) INTERNATIONAL DATA
# ============================================================

international_plot_df <- animal_qr_counts %>%
  filter(

  )

p_international_qr <- ggplot(

) +

    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
```

```{r}


# ============================================================
# SEN
# INTERNATIONAL + OTHER-US
# ANIMAL SOURCE AND QR/FQR ANALYSIS
#
# OUTPUT:
#   1. International original animal-source counts
#   2. International animal-source × QR/FQR
#   3. Other-US original animal-source counts
#   4. Other-US animal-source × QR/FQR
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 0) LIBRARIES
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)


id_col <- "Isolate"


# ============================================================
# 1) QR/FQR STATUS
#
# Uses the existing SEN_fqr_tokens object
# Any isolate present in SEN_fqr_tokens is classified as
# having a QR/FQR marker.
# ============================================================

qr_isolates <- SEN_fqr_tokens %>%
  distinct(isolate_id) %>%
  mutate(
    isolate_id = as.character(isolate_id),
    QR_status = "QR/FQR marker"
  )


# ============================================================
# 2) EXTRACT THE TWO CERTIFIED GROUPS
#
# International-Non-US -> International
# Other-US-US           -> Other-US
#
# Then refine animal source using Isolation source
# ============================================================

source_animal_qr <- SEN %>%

  filter(
    Source_group %in% c(
      "International-Non-US",
      "Other-US-US"
    )
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # Standardize isolate ID
    isolate_id = as.character(.data[[id_col]]),

    # Rename the two analysis groups
    Group = recode(
      Source_group,
      "International-Non-US" = "International",
      "Other-US-US" = "Other-US"
    ),

    # Clean Isolation source
    isolation_clean = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(
        as.character(`Isolation source`)
      )
    ),

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Animal-source classification
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    Animal_source = case_when(

      # Chicken
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(chicken|broiler|hen)\\b"
      ) ~ "Chicken",

      # Turkey
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\bturkey\\b"
      ) ~ "Turkey",

      # Cattle
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(cattle|bovine|beef|steer|calf|veal|bos taurus)\\b"
      ) ~ "Cattle",

      # Sheep / goat
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(sheep|lamb|ovine|goat|caprine)\\b"
      ) ~ "Sheep/goat",

      # Swine
      str_detect(
        isolation_clean,
        "\\b(swine|sow|pork|porcine)\\b"
      ) ~ "Swine",

      # Everything else
      TRUE ~ "Others"
    )
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # One row per isolate
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  distinct(
    isolate_id,
    Group,
    Animal_source
  ) %>%

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add QR/FQR classification
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  left_join(
    qr_isolates,
    by = "isolate_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    # Anything not found in SEN_fqr_tokens is susceptible
    QR_status = if_else(
      is.na(QR_status),
      "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      QR_status
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)   # for unit()

amr_col <- "AMR genotypes"

# -----------------------------
# Helper: bin % into categories
# -----------------------------
pct_bins <- function(x) {
  cut(
    x,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 0, 5, 10, 20, 40, 50, 60, 80, Inf),
    labels = c(
      "0",
      "1-5",
      "6-10",
      "10-20",
      "20-40",
      "40-50",
      "50-60",
      "60-80",
      "80+"
    ),
    right = TRUE
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper: pretty/correct gene casing for display
# -----------------------------
pretty_token <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\s+", "")

  # normalize delimiters
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "-", "_")

  fix_start <- function(s, from, to) {
    str_replace(s, paste0("^", from), to)
  }

  # chromosomal targets
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyra", "gyrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "gyrb", "gyrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "parc", "parC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pare", "parE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pard", "parD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "grla", "grlA")

  # qnr family
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnras", "qnrAS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnra",  "qnrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrb",  "qnrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrc",  "qnrC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrd",  "qnrD")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnre",  "qnrE")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrs",  "qnrS")
  x <- fix_start(x, "qnrvc", "qnrVC")

  # other families
  x <- fix_start(x, "qepa", "qepA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "nfxb", "nfxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "emrr", "emrR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "norm", "norM")
  x <- fix_start(x, "pmra", "pmrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "acrb", "acrB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "smef", "smeF")

  # prior extras
  x <- fix_start(x, "acra", "acrA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "tolc", "tolC")
  x <- fix_start(x, "crpp", "crpP")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxa", "oqxA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "oqxb", "oqxB")
  x <- fix_start(x, "rama", "ramA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "ramr", "ramR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "mara", "marA")
  x <- fix_start(x, "marr", "marR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxr", "soxR")
  x <- fix_start(x, "soxs", "soxS")

  # enzyme token
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x,
    "^aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr",
    "aac(6')-Ib-cr"
  )

  # uppercase mutation/suffix after underscore
  parts <- str_split_fixed(x, "_", 2)

  gene_part <- parts[, 1]
  rest_part <- parts[, 2]

  rest_part <- ifelse(
    rest_part == "",
    rest_part,
    toupper(rest_part)
  )

  x <- ifelse(
    rest_part == "",
    gene_part,
    paste0(gene_part, "_", rest_part)
  )

  x
}


# =========================================================
# 0) Assign origin (US vs Non-US), then build Source groups
#    Collapse ALL Non-US into "International"
# =========================================================

usa_pat <- "(\\busa\\b|\\bunited\\s*states\\b|\\bu\\s*\\.\\s*s\\s*\\.\\b|\\bus\\b)"
id_pat  <- "(\\bcfsan\\b|\\bfda\\b)"

source_levels <- c(
  "Human",
  "Chicken-US",
  "Other-US",
  "International"
)

SEN <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    Source = as.character(Source),

    Strain_l = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(Strain))
    ),

    IsoID_l = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(`Isolate identifiers`))
    ),

    Food_l = str_to_lower(
      str_squish(as.character(`Food origin`))
    ),

    Strain_l = if_else(
      is.na(Strain_l),
      "",
      Strain_l
    ),

    IsoID_l = if_else(
      is.na(IsoID_l),
      "",
      IsoID_l
    ),

    Food_l = if_else(
      is.na(Food_l),
      "",
      Food_l
    ),

    is_fda_like =
      str_detect(Strain_l, "^fda") |
      str_detect(IsoID_l, id_pat),

    is_us_food =
      str_detect(Food_l, usa_pat) |
      Food_l == "",

    origin_tag = if_else(
      is_fda_like & !is_us_food,
      "Non-US",
      "US"
    ),

    Source = case_when(
      str_to_lower(Source) == "human" ~
        "Human",

      str_to_lower(Source) == "chicken" ~
        paste0("Chicken-", origin_tag),

      str_to_lower(Source) == "other" ~
        paste0("Other-", origin_tag),

      TRUE ~ Source
    ),

    Source = case_when(
      Source %in% c(
        "Chicken-Non-US",
        "Other-Non-US"
      ) ~ "International",

      TRUE ~ Source
    ),

    Source = factor(
      Source,
      levels = source_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -Strain_l,
    -IsoID_l,
    -Food_l,
    -is_fda_like,
    -is_us_food,
    -origin_tag
  )


# =========================================================
# N per Source for facet labels
# =========================================================

src_N <- SEN %>%
  count(
    Source,
    name = "N_total"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_chr = as.character(Source),

    Source_lab = paste0(
      Source_chr,
      " (N=",
      N_total,
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      Source_chr,
      levels = source_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = Source_lab
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Source,
    Source_lab
  )


# =========================================================
# 1) TOKENIZE + keep ALL QR tokens
# =========================================================

qr_regex <- regex(
  paste0(
    "^(",
    "(gyr[a-b](?:_.+)?|par[c-e](?:_.+)?|grla(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(qnr(as|[a-z0-9._-]*))(?:$)|",
    "(qnrvc[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(qep[a-z0-9._-]*)(?:$)|",
    "(nfxb(?:_.+)?|emrr(?:_.+)?|norm(?:_.+)?|pmra(?:_.+)?|acrb(?:_.+)?|smef(?:_.+)?)(?:$)|",
    "(aac\\(6'\\)-ib-cr(?:_.+)?|oqx[a-b](?:_.+)?|crpp(?:_.+)?|acr[a-b](?:_.+)?|tolc(?:_.+)?|ram[ar](?:_.+)?|mar[ar](?:_.+)?|sox[rs](?:_.+)?)(?:$)",
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)


tok_long <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),

    Collection_year = as.integer(
      Collection_year
    ),

    amr_txt = as.character(
      .data[[amr_col]]
    ),

    amr_txt = if_else(
      is.na(amr_txt),
      "",
      amr_txt
    ),

    token = str_extract_all(
      amr_txt,
      "[^,=\\s]+(?==)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    token
  ) %>%
  unnest_longer(
    token
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    token = str_trim(token),

    token = str_replace_all(
      token,
      "\\s+",
      ""
    ),

    token_norm = str_to_lower(
      token
    ),

    token_pretty = pretty_token(
      token_norm
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Collection_year),
    Collection_year >= 1990,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  )


tok_qr <- tok_long %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      token_norm,
      qr_regex
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 2) Pick TOP 5 QR TOKENS overall
#    rest -> "others"
# =========================================================

top5_tokens <- tok_qr %>%
  count(
    token_pretty,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(n)
  ) %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 5
  ) %>%
  pull(
    token_pretty
  )


marker_long <- tok_qr %>%
  mutate(
    marker_group = if_else(
      token_pretty %in% top5_tokens,
      token_pretty,
      "others"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    row_id,
    Source,
    Collection_year,
    marker_group
  )


top5_lower <- str_to_lower(
  top5_tokens
)

top5_ordered <- c(

  top5_tokens[
    str_detect(
      top5_lower,
      "^gyra(_|$)"
    )
  ],

  top5_tokens[
    str_detect(
      top5_lower,
      "^qnrb"
    )
  ],

  top5_tokens[
    !str_detect(
      top5_lower,
      "^gyra(_|$)"
    ) &
      !str_detect(
        top5_lower,
        "^qnrb"
      )
  ]
)

top5_ordered <- unique(
  top5_ordered
)

marker_levels <- c(
  top5_ordered,
  "others"
)


# =========================================================

year_levels <- c(
```

#stacked bar plot over time
```{r}

# =========================================================
# STACKED BAR PLOTS:
#
# 1. PERCENT VERSION
# 2. COUNT VERSION
#
# QR/FQR marker      = red3
# Q/FQ-susceptible   = green4
#
# Same years as dot plot:
#   ≤2000
#   2001
#   2002
#   ...
#   2025
#
# Years with NO genomes have NO bar.
#
# COUNT VERSION:
# Total genome count is written vertically above each bar.
# =========================================================


# =========================================================
# 1) IDENTIFY GENOMES WITH ≥1 QR/FQR MARKER
# =========================================================

qr_positive_rows <- tok_qr %>%
  distinct(
    row_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    QR_status = "QR/FQR marker"
  )


# =========================================================
# 2) ASSIGN ONE QR/FQR STATUS TO EVERY GENOME
#
# ≥1 QR/FQR marker  -> QR/FQR marker
# no QR/FQR marker  -> Q/FQ-susceptible
# =========================================================

SEN_qr_status <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),

    Collection_year = as.integer(
      Collection_year
    ),

    year_plot = if_else(
      Collection_year <= 2000,
      "≤2000",
      as.character(
        Collection_year
      )
    )
  ) %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(Collection_year),
    Collection_year >= 1990,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  ) %>%

  left_join(
    qr_positive_rows,
    by = "row_id"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    QR_status = if_else(
      is.na(QR_status),
      "Q/FQ-susceptible",
      QR_status
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 3) COUNT GENOMES PER
#    SOURCE × YEAR × QR/FQR STATUS
#
# IMPORTANT:
# We deliberately DO NOT use complete() here.
#
# Therefore:
#   N = 0 -> NO BAR
#
# But scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) below keeps the
# corresponding year position visible on the x-axis.
# =========================================================

year_qr_stack <- SEN_qr_status %>%
  count(
    Source,
    year_plot,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%

  group_by(
    Source,
    year_plot
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    N_year = sum(n),

    pct = 100 * n / N_year
  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  left_join(
    src_N,
    by = "Source"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    Source_lab = factor(
      Source_lab,
      levels = levels(
        src_N$Source_lab
      )
    ),

    year_plot = factor(
      year_plot,
      levels = year_levels
    ),

    QR_status = factor(
      QR_status,
      levels = c(
        "Q/FQ-susceptible",
        "QR/FQR marker"
      )
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 4) CREATE ONE TOTAL COUNT PER SOURCE × YEAR
#
# This is used ONLY for writing the total number of
# genomes above each stacked bar in the count plot.
# =========================================================

year_qr_totals <- year_qr_stack %>%
  distinct(
    Source,
    Source_lab,
    year_plot,
    N_year
  )


# =========================================================
# 5) OPTIONAL CHECK OF DATA USED IN BOTH PLOTS
# =========================================================

print(
  year_qr_stack,
  n = Inf
)

print(
  year_qr_totals,
  n = Inf
)


# =========================================================
# 6) PERCENTAGE STACKED BAR PLOT
#
# Every bar represents 100% of genomes sampled from
# that Source during that year.
# =========================================================

p_year_qr_stack_pct <- ggplot(

  )
) +

      )

  ) +

  labs(

  ) +

  theme_bw() +

    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 7
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(

    ),

    ),

    ),

    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(

    ),

  )

#

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCTION FOR INTEGER-ONLY Y-AXIS BREAKS
# ---------------------------------------------------------

integer_breaks <- function(x) {

  b <- pretty(
    x,
    n = 5
  )

  b <- b[
    b >= 0 &
    b >= x[1] &
    b <= x[2] &
    abs(b - round(b)) < 1e-8
  ]

  unique(
    as.integer(
      round(b)
    )
  )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# COUNT PLOT
# ---------------------------------------------------------

  # -------------------------------------------------------

  #

  #

  # -------------------------------------------------------

  scale_y_continuous(

    ),

    ),
```

#Diversity and Enrichment score and Plotting
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# =========================================================
# A) Build iso_mat from marker_long (one row per isolate)
# =========================================================
source_levels <- c("Human", "Chicken-US", "Other-US", "International")

iso_mat <- marker_long %>%
  mutate(value = 1L) %>%
  select(row_id, Source, marker_group, value) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(row_id, Source),
    names_from  = marker_group,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = list(value = 0L)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels))

# ensure marker_levels match the columns in iso_mat
marker_levels <- setdiff(names(iso_mat), c("row_id", "Source"))

# =========================================================
# B) Hill numbers helper (q0, q1, q2)
# =========================================================
hill_numbers <- function(p) {
  p <- as.numeric(p)
  p <- p[is.finite(p) & p > 0]
  if (length(p) == 0) return(c(q0 = 0, q1 = 0, q2 = 0))
  q0 <- length(p)
  q1 <- exp(-sum(p * log(p)))   # Exponential Shannon
  q2 <- 1 / sum(p^2)            # Inverse Simpson
  c(q0 = q0, q1 = q1, q2 = q2)
}

# =========================================================
# C) Point estimates q0/q1/q2 per Source
# =========================================================
div_point <- iso_mat %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    across(all_of(marker_levels), ~ mean(.x)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    s = sum(c_across(all_of(marker_levels))),
    p = list(if (s > 0) c_across(all_of(marker_levels)) / s else rep(0, length(marker_levels))),
    q0 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q0"],
    q1 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q1"],
    q2 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q2"]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Source, N, q0, q1, q2) %>%
  arrange(Source)

# =========================================================
# D) Bootstrap 95% CI for q0/q1/q2
# =========================================================
set.seed(1)
B <- 1000

boot_source <- function(df_source) {
  X <- as.matrix(df_source[, marker_levels, drop = FALSE])
  n <- nrow(X)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = 3)
  colnames(out) <- c("q0", "q1", "q2")
  if (n == 0) return(as.data.frame(out))

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    prev <- colMeans(X[idx, , drop = FALSE])
    s <- sum(prev)
    p <- if (s > 0) prev / s else rep(0, length(prev))
    out[b, ] <- hill_numbers(p)
  }
  as.data.frame(out)
}

boot_res <- split(iso_mat, iso_mat$Source) %>%
  lapply(boot_source) %>%
  Map(function(df, nm) { df$Source <- nm; df }, ., names(.)) %>%
  bind_rows()

div_ci <- boot_res %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(
    q0_lo = quantile(q0, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q0_hi = quantile(q0, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_lo = quantile(q1, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_hi = quantile(q1, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    q2_lo = quantile(q2, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q2_hi = quantile(q2, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

div_sum <- div_point %>%
  left_join(div_ci, by = "Source") %>%
  mutate(Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels)) %>%
  arrange(Source)

print(div_sum, n = Inf)
write.csv(div_sum, "QR_diversity_q0_q1_q2_bySource_with95CI.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# E) Composition table from iso_mat
# =========================================================
comp_tbl <- iso_mat %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(marker_levels), ~ mean(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(marker_levels),
    names_to = "marker_group",
    values_to = "prevalence"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  mutate(
    denom = sum(prevalence),
    p = if_else(denom > 0, prevalence / denom, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-denom) %>%
  mutate(
    Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels),
    marker_group = factor(marker_group, levels = marker_levels)
  )

write.csv(comp_tbl, "QR_composition_bySource.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# F) Permutation tests: global + pairwise (q1, q2)
# =========================================================
calc_div_by_source <- function(df_mat) {
  df_mat %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(marker_levels), ~ mean(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      s = sum(c_across(all_of(marker_levels))),
      p = list(if (s > 0) c_across(all_of(marker_levels)) / s else rep(0, length(marker_levels))),
      q1 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q1"],
      q2 = hill_numbers(unlist(p))["q2"]
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Source = factor(as.character(Source), levels = source_levels)) %>%
    arrange(Source) %>%
    select(Source, q1, q2)
}

global_stat <- function(v) max(v, na.rm = TRUE) - min(v, na.rm = TRUE)

perm_global_test <- function(df_mat, metric = c("q1", "q2"), nperm = 2000, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  obs <- calc_div_by_source(df_mat)
  obs_stat <- global_stat(obs[[metric]])

  perm_stats <- numeric(nperm)
  for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
    dfp <- df_mat
    dfp$Source <- sample(dfp$Source)
    perm <- calc_div_by_source(dfp)
    perm_stats[i] <- global_stat(perm[[metric]])
  }

  tibble(metric = metric, obs_stat = obs_stat, p_value = mean(perm_stats >= obs_stat))
}

perm_pairwise <- function(df_mat, metric = c("q1", "q2"), nperm = 2000, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  metric <- match.arg(metric)

  pairs <- combn(source_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  res <- lapply(pairs, function(p) {
    a <- p[1]; b <- p[2]
    df2 <- df_mat %>% filter(as.character(Source) %in% c(a, b))

    obs <- calc_div_by_source(df2)
    obs_a <- obs %>% filter(as.character(Source) == a) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
    obs_b <- obs %>% filter(as.character(Source) == b) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
    obs_diff <- abs(obs_a - obs_b)

    perm_d <- numeric(nperm)
    for (i in seq_len(nperm)) {
      dfp <- df2
      dfp$Source <- sample(dfp$Source)
      perm <- calc_div_by_source(dfp)
      pa <- perm %>% filter(as.character(Source) == a) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
      pb <- perm %>% filter(as.character(Source) == b) %>% pull(!!sym(metric))
      perm_d[i] <- abs(pa - pb)
    }

    tibble(metric = metric,
           group1 = a,
           group2 = b,
           obs_diff = obs_diff,
           p_value = mean(perm_d >= obs_diff))
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  res %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(p_adj_BH)
}

N_PERM <- 2000
global_q1 <- perm_global_test(iso_mat, "q1", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 101)
global_q2 <- perm_global_test(iso_mat, "q2", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 102)
pair_q1   <- perm_pairwise(iso_mat, "q1", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 201)
pair_q2   <- perm_pairwise(iso_mat, "q2", nperm = N_PERM, seed = 202)

print(global_q1)
print(global_q2)
print(pair_q1, n = Inf)
print(pair_q2, n = Inf)

write.csv(global_q1, "QR_diversity_global_perm_q1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(global_q2, "QR_diversity_global_perm_q2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pair_q1,   "QR_diversity_pairwise_perm_q1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pair_q2,   "QR_diversity_pairwise_perm_q2.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# G) Shannon + Simpson + composition patchwork
#
# All three plots have EXACTLY the same height.
# Shannon and Simpson are each 10% wider than composition.

letters_df <- tibble(
```

#Strategizing for 3000-3500 Genome selection
## FINAL TARGETS 
# <2018: max 1400
# >=2018: 2100 total, with +100 added to HUMAN only:
#   +50 to 2018–2020 human, +50 to 2021–2025 human

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BLOCK A (<2018)  = 1400 max (time + source balanced)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Rule A1: include ALL QR <2018 (fixed)
#   all_QR_pre2018 = 689  (your number)

# Rule A2: fill remainder with NON-QR to reach 1400, keeping source balance
# Pre-2018 totals (suggested):
#   Human   = 820 total (QR + NON-QR)
#   Chicken = 380 total
#   Other   = 200 total
# Total    = 1400
#
# Implementation rule:
#   - take ALL QR <2018 for each source (Human/Chicken/Other)
#   - then sample NON-QR within each source to hit its target total
#   - if a source cannot hit its target due to limited genomes, reallocate deficit:
#         first to Chicken (if deficit in Other), then Human; keep totals = 1400

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BLOCK B (>=2018) = 2100 total (time-stratified + source-stratified)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Split >=2018 into two sections:
#   Section 1: 2018–2020  = 800 + 50 (human-only) = 850
#   Section 2: 2021–2025  = 1200 + 50 (human-only) = 1250
#
# Section 1 (2018–2020) totals:
#   Human   = 500   (450 + 50 added)
#   Chicken = 250
#   Other   = 100
#   Total   = 850
#
# Section 2 (2021–2025) totals:
#   Human   = 700   (650 + 50 added)
#   Chicken = 400
#   Other   = 150
#   Total   = 1250
#
# Within EACH (section × source):
#   target QR/NON-QR ≈ 70/30
#   - Human 2018–2020: 350 QR / 150 NON-QR
#   - Human 2021–2025: 490 QR / 210 NON-QR
#   - Chicken 2018–2020: 175 QR / 75 NON-QR
#   - Chicken 2021–2025: 280 QR / 120 NON-QR
#   - Other 2018–2020: 70 QR / 30 NON-QR
#   - Other 2021–2025: 105 QR / 45 NON-QR
#
# Marker representation constraints (apply inside >=2018 blocks):
#   - Guarantee minimum representation IF PRESENT (otherwise take all available):
#       qnr*                >= 30 total
#       parC/parE mutations >= 25 total
#       oqxA/oqxB            >= 15 total
#       qepA                 >= 15 total
#       aac(6')-Ib-cr         >= 15 total
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QUICK CHECK: totals
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# <2018: 1400
# >=2018: 850 + 1250 = 2100
# TOTAL: 3500

#For the "Outbreak" column, only one QR and non-QR must be selected in each outbreak/year if available, and "Location": must select representatives of all loaction present per year 

```{r}
## ============================================================
## FINAL 3500-GENOME SELECTION SCRIPT
## GUARANTEE: ALL NON-US INCLUDED
## ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

## -----------------------------
## CONFIG
## -----------------------------
year_cut <- 2018
target_total <- 3500

A_total <- 1400

A_targets <- tibble(
  Source3 = c("Human","Chicken","Other"),
  target  = c(820, 380, 200)
)

B_sections <- tibble(
  section = c("2018-2020","2021-2025"),
  y_min   = c(2018, 2021),
  y_max   = c(2020, 2025),
  total   = c(850, 1250)
)

B_targets <- tibble(
  section = rep(B_sections$section, each = 3),
  Source3 = rep(c("Human","Chicken","Other"), times = 2),
  target  = c(500,250,100, 700,400,150)
) %>%
  mutate(
    target_QR  = round(target * 0.70),
    target_NQR = target - target_QR
  )

## -----------------------------
## HELPERS
## -----------------------------
clean_na <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA","N/A","none","null")] <- NA
  x
}

make_source3 <- function(x) {
  s <- tolower(x)
  case_when(
    str_detect(s,"human")   ~ "Human",
    str_detect(s,"chicken") ~ "Chicken",
    str_detect(s,"other")   ~ "Other",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

is_non_us <- function(x) {
  str_detect(tolower(x), "non-us|nonus|non_us")
}

assign_amr_pattern <- function(amr) {
  a <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(amr), "", amr))
  case_when(
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?d87y") ~ "gyrA_d87Y",
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?d87n") ~ "gyrA_d87N",
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?s83y") ~ "gyrA_s83Y",
    str_detect(a,"gyra[_-]?d87g") ~ "gyrA_d87G",
    str_detect(a,"qnrb19")        ~ "qnrB19",
    TRUE                          ~ "others"
  )
}

safe_sample <- function(df, n) {
  if (n <= 0 || nrow(df) == 0) return(df[0,])
  slice_sample(df, n = min(n, nrow(df)))
}

## -----------------------------
## PREP DATA
## -----------------------------
SEN_work <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    row_id = row_number(),
    Year   = as.integer(Collection_year),
    Source_raw = Source,
    Source3 = make_source3(Source),
    NonUS  = is_non_us(Source),
    QR_group = if_else(QR_genotype == 1L, "QR","NON-QR"),
    Outbreak_clean = clean_na(Outbreak),
    Location_clean = clean_na(Location),
    AMR_pattern = assign_amr_pattern(`AMR genotypes`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2025)

## ============================================================
## 🔒 FORCE-INCLUDE ALL NON-US
## ============================================================
forced_nonUS <- SEN_work %>% filter(NonUS)

SEN_work_remain <- SEN_work %>%
  anti_join(forced_nonUS, by = "row_id")

cat("Forced-in Non-US:", nrow(forced_nonUS), "\n")

## Adjust total targets
remaining_budget <- target_total - nrow(forced_nonUS)
if (remaining_budget <= 0) {
  stop("Non-US isolates exceed target_total — increase target_total")
}

## ============================================================
## BLOCK A (<2018)
## ============================================================
A_pool <- SEN_work_remain %>% filter(Year < year_cut)

A_QR <- A_pool %>% filter(QR_group=="QR")

A_plan <- A_targets %>%
  left_join(count(A_QR, Source3, name="nQR"), by="Source3") %>%
  mutate(
    nQR = replace_na(nQR,0),
    nNQ = pmax(target - nQR, 0)
  )

A_NQR <- A_plan %>%
  mutate(pick = map2(Source3, nNQ, ~{
    A_pool %>% filter(Source3==.x, QR_group=="NON-QR") %>% safe_sample(.y)
  })) %>%
  select(pick) %>% unnest(cols = pick)

A_sel <- bind_rows(A_QR, A_NQR) %>% distinct(row_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

if (nrow(A_sel) < A_total) {
  rem <- A_pool %>% anti_join(A_sel, by="row_id")
  A_sel <- bind_rows(A_sel, safe_sample(rem, A_total - nrow(A_sel)))
}

## ============================================================
## BLOCK B (>=2018)
## ============================================================
B_pool <- SEN_work_remain %>% filter(Year >= year_cut)

B_sel <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(B_targets)), function(i){

  sec <- B_targets$section[i]
  s3  <- B_targets$Source3[i]
  tQR <- B_targets$target_QR[i]
  tNQ <- B_targets$target_NQR[i]

  yrs <- B_sections %>% filter(section==sec)
  pool <- B_pool %>%
    filter(Year >= yrs$y_min, Year <= yrs$y_max, Source3==s3)

  picked <- pool[0,]

  fill_group <- function(qr_label, need_n) {
    rem <- pool %>% anti_join(picked, by="row_id") %>% filter(QR_group==qr_label)
    if (need_n <= 0 || nrow(rem)==0) return(rem[0,])

    map_dfr(unique(rem$Year), function(y){
      py <- rem %>% filter(Year==y)
      if (nrow(py)==0) return(py)

      props <- py %>% count(AMR_pattern) %>% mutate(w=n/sum(n))
      alloc <- props %>% mutate(n_take=round(w*need_n))
      py %>% left_join(alloc, by="AMR_pattern") %>%
        group_by(AMR_pattern) %>%
        group_modify(~ safe_sample(.x, unique(.x$n_take))) %>%
        ungroup()
    })
  }

  picked <- bind_rows(
    fill_group("QR", tQR),
    fill_group("NON-QR", tNQ)
  ) %>% distinct(row_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

  picked %>% slice_head(n=tQR+tNQ) %>% mutate(section=sec)
})

## ============================================================
## FINAL MERGE
## ============================================================
sel_all <- bind_rows(
  forced_nonUS,
  A_sel %>% mutate(section="<2018"),
  B_sel
) %>% distinct(row_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

if (nrow(sel_all) > target_total) {
  keep_nonUS <- sel_all %>% filter(NonUS)
  rest <- sel_all %>% filter(!NonUS)
  sel_all <- bind_rows(
    keep_nonUS,
    safe_sample(rest, target_total - nrow(keep_nonUS))
  )
}

cat("FINAL N =", nrow(sel_all), "\n")

write.csv(sel_all, "Selected_3500_genomes.csv", row.names=FALSE)

```
