```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================================================
# INPUTS (selected genomes only)
# =========================================================
# If you already have your selected set in memory, set:
#   SEL <- sel_all
# Otherwise read from the file you wrote:
SEL <- read.csv("Selected_3500_genomes.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# =========================================================
# CONFIG
# =========================================================
amr_col    <- "AMR genotypes"
year_col   <- "Collection_year"
source_col <- "Source"
qr_col     <- "QR_genotype"

source_levels <- c("Human", "Chicken-US", "Chicken-Non-US", "Other-US", "Other-Non-US")

# Major QR markers (from your chart y-axis)
major_markers <- c("gyra_d87y", "gyra_d87n", "gyra_s83y", "gyra_d87g", "qnrb19")
marker_levels <- c(major_markers, "other_qr", "non_qr")  # add NON-QR to the stack

# =========================================================
# HELPERS
# =========================================================
clean_txt <- function(x){
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "", x)
  str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
}

extract_tokens <- function(amr_txt){
  amr_txt <- clean_txt(amr_txt)
  toks <- str_extract_all(amr_txt, "[^,=\\s]+(?==)")[[1]]
  toks <- str_to_lower(str_replace_all(str_trim(toks), "\\s+", ""))
  toks[toks != ""]
}

# classify each row into ONE bucket:
#  - NON-QR -> "non_qr"
#  - QR -> top gyrA markers first, then qnrb19, else "other_qr"
row_bucket <- function(tokens, is_qr){
  if (is.na(is_qr) || is_qr != 1L) return("non_qr")
  if (length(tokens) == 0) return("other_qr")

  toks <- str_to_lower(tokens)
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^gyra_", "gyra_")
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^gyrA_", "gyra_")
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^gyra", "gyra")
  toks <- str_replace_all(toks, "^qnrb19$", "qnrb19")

  # priority: gyrA major markers first
  for (m in major_markers[grepl("^gyra_", major_markers)]) {
    if (any(toks == m)) return(m)
  }
  # then qnrb19
  if (any(toks %in% c("qnrb19","qnr_b19","qnr-b19","qnrb_19","qnrB19"))) return("qnrb19")

  "other_qr"
}

make_year3 <- function(y){
  y <- as.integer(y)
  start <- y - ((y - min(y, na.rm = TRUE)) %% 3)
  paste0(start, "-", start + 2)
}

# =========================================================
# BUILD STACKED COUNTS (SELECTED ONLY) + NON-QR INCLUDED
# =========================================================
df_plot <- SEL %>%
  mutate(
    Year   = as.integer(.data[[year_col]]),
    Source = as.character(.data[[source_col]]),
    Source = factor(Source, levels = source_levels),
    is_qr  = as.integer(.data[[qr_col]]),
    amr_txt = .data[[amr_col]]
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2025, !is.na(Source)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    tokens = list(extract_tokens(amr_txt)),
    bucket = row_bucket(tokens, is_qr)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    year3  = make_year3(Year),
    bucket = factor(bucket, levels = marker_levels)
  ) %>%
  count(Source, year3, bucket, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  complete(year3, bucket, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# order x-axis chronologically
year3_levels <- df_plot %>%
  distinct(year3) %>%
  mutate(start = as.integer(str_extract(year3, "^\\d{4}"))) %>%
  arrange(start) %>%
  pull(year3)

df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(year3 = factor(year3, levels = year3_levels))

# =========================================================
# PLOT
# =========================================================
p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = year3, y = n, fill = bucket)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~ Source, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Collection year (3-year groups)",
    y = "Selected genomes (count)",
    fill = "QR bucket"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text   = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)

# Optional save
# ggsave("SelectedGenomes_majorQR_plus_nonQR_3yr_by_source.png", p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 600)


```

#selection description
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# =========================================================
# 1) FORCE RELOAD OF FINAL 3434-GENOME DATASET
# =========================================================

rm(SEL)

SEL <- read_csv(
  "Finalupdated_SEN_Genomes1.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# =========================================================
# 2) VERIFY CORRECT FILE
# =========================================================

cat("Rows =", nrow(SEL), "\n")

cat(
  "QR columns found:\n"
)

print(
  grep(
    "QR",
    names(SEL),
    value = TRUE
  )
)

# This MUST pass
stopifnot(nrow(SEL) == 3434)
stopifnot("QR_genotype" %in% names(SEL))


# =========================================================
# 3) CREATE METHODS VARIABLES
# =========================================================

SEL_methods <- SEL %>%
  mutate(
    Collection_year = as.integer(
      .data[["Collection_year"]]
    ),

    International =
      .data[["Source"]] == "International",

    QR_status = if_else(
      as.integer(.data[["QR_genotype"]]) == 1L,
      "QR/FQR",
      "FQS"
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# 4) INTERNATIONAL
# =========================================================

n_international <- SEL_methods %>%
  filter(International) %>%
  nrow()


# =========================================================
# 5) TEMPORAL DATA
#    EXCLUDE INTERNATIONAL SO THEY ARE NOT DOUBLE-COUNTED
# =========================================================

temporal <- SEL_methods %>%
  filter(
    !International,
    !is.na(Collection_year)
  )


# =========================================================
# 6) METHODS COUNTS
# =========================================================

methods_counts <- temporal %>%
  mutate(
    Period = if_else(
      Collection_year < 2018,
      "Pre-2018",
      "2018-2025"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    Period,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  )

print(methods_counts)


# =========================================================
# 7) EXTRACT NUMBERS
# =========================================================

pre_fqr <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year < 2018,
    QR_status == "QR/FQR"
  ) %>%
  nrow()

pre_fqs <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year < 2018,
    QR_status == "FQS"
  ) %>%
  nrow()

post_fqr <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year >= 2018,
    Collection_year <= 2025,
    QR_status == "QR/FQR"
  ) %>%
  nrow()

post_fqs <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year >= 2018,
    Collection_year <= 2025,
    QR_status == "FQS"
  ) %>%
  nrow()


# =========================================================
# 8) 2018-2020 / 2021-2025 BREAKDOWN
# =========================================================

later_breakdown <- temporal %>%
  filter(
    Collection_year >= 2018,
    Collection_year <= 2025
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Period = case_when(
      Collection_year <= 2020 ~ "2018-2020",
      Collection_year >= 2021 ~ "2021-2025"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    Period,
    QR_status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(n),
    Percent = round(100 * n / Total, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(later_breakdown)


# =========================================================
# 9) FINAL TOTAL
# =========================================================

final_total <-
  n_international +
  pre_fqr +
  pre_fqs +
  post_fqr +
  post_fqs

cat(
  "\n============================\n",
  "International     =", n_international, "\n",
  "Pre-2018 QR/FQR   =", pre_fqr, "\n",
  "Pre-2018 FQS      =", pre_fqs, "\n",
  "2018-2025 QR/FQR  =", post_fqr, "\n",
  "2018-2025 FQS     =", post_fqs, "\n",
  "TOTAL             =", final_total, "\n",
  "============================\n"
)

stopifnot(final_total == 3434)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

set.seed(123)

## -----------------------------
## HELPERS (same as original)
## -----------------------------
clean_na <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "none", "null")] <- NA
  x
}

make_source3 <- function(x) {
  s <- tolower(x)
  case_when(
    str_detect(s, "human")   ~ "Human",
    str_detect(s, "chicken") ~ "Chicken",
    str_detect(s, "other")   ~ "Other",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

is_non_us <- function(x) {
  str_detect(tolower(x), "non-us|nonus|non_us")
}

assign_amr_pattern <- function(amr) {
  a <- tolower(ifelse(is.na(amr), "", amr))
  case_when(
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?d87y") ~ "gyrA_d87Y",
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?d87n") ~ "gyrA_d87N",
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?s83y") ~ "gyrA_s83Y",
    str_detect(a, "gyra[_-]?d87g") ~ "gyrA_d87G",
    str_detect(a, "qnrb19")        ~ "qnrB19",
    TRUE                           ~ "others"
  )
}

## -----------------------------
## 1) BUILD SEN_work WITH ALL YOUR LOGIC
## -----------------------------
SEN_work <- SEN %>%
  mutate(
    # keep original Strain / Isolate but trimmed for safer matching
    Strain  = str_squish(as.character(Strain)),
    Isolate = str_squish(as.character(Isolate)),

    row_id = row_number(),
    Year   = as.integer(Collection_year),
    Source_raw = Source,
    Source3 = make_source3(Source),
    NonUS  = is_non_us(Source),
    QR_group = if_else(QR_genotype == 1L, "QR", "NON-QR"),
    Outbreak_clean = clean_na(Outbreak),
    Location_clean = clean_na(Location),
    AMR_pattern = assign_amr_pattern(`AMR genotypes`)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year >= 1990, Year <= 2025)

## -----------------------------
## 2) READ KEY FILE (Strain, Isolate) AND TRIM
## -----------------------------
keys <- read_csv("Selected_updated_Isolate.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Strain  = str_squish(as.character(Strain)),
    Isolate = str_squish(as.character(Isolate))
  )

## -----------------------------
## 3) SUBSET SEN_work BY (Strain, Isolate)
## -----------------------------
SEN_final <- SEN_work %>%
  semi_join(keys, by = c("Strain", "Isolate"))

# How many matched?
nrow(SEN_final)

## -----------------------------
## 4) SAVE FULL SUBSET (ALL COLS FROM SEN_work)
## -----------------------------
write_csv(SEN_final, "Finalupdated_SEN_Genomes.csv")

```
